style: .dm-hub{font-family:Inter,sans-serif}.dm-hero{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;align-items:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0f766e,#16a34a);color:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:18px;margin-bottom:14px}.dm-kicker{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.85;letter-spacing:.08em}.dm-hero h2{margin:2px 0;font-size:22px}.dm-hero p{margin:0;opacity:.9}.dm-open{background:#fff;color:#14532d;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:999px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600}.dm-hero-btnrow{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end}.dm-sections{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(360px,1fr));gap:12px}.dm-section{border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;background:#fff}.dm-section h3{margin:0 0 8px 0;font-size:16px}.dm-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}.dm-grid h4{margin:0 0 6px 0;font-size:13px;color:#6b7280}.dm-grid a{display:block;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none;color:#111827;background:#f9fafb;margin-bottom:6px}.dm-grid a:hover{background:#ecfeff}@media (max-width:768px){.dm-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
